285080218.description: This lot includes four vintage used vacuum tubes from National brand: 2C39 and 7289 models. Made in the USA, these tubes feature metal and ceramic construction. They were typically used as radio frequency power amplifiers in industrial, military, and amateur radio equipment. Tubes show signs of wear and oxidation, with handwritten notes on bases indicating previous use and condition, such as 'R. Final 2C39 5-20-85 USED' and '+V.G.++'. All tubes appear structurally intact but are sold as used and may require testing or refurbishment before operational use. Suitable for collectors, restorers, or those needing period-correct replacements for vintage RF or transmitter gear. not tested

284898242.description:
Hemingray Glass Company
Telegraph Insulator on Iron Wall Bracket
Pressed Glass, Aqua, Antique
Antique Hemingray telegraph and telephone glass insulator mounted on an original curved iron bracket. Featuring Hemingray's patented May 2, 1893 drip-point base designed to shed rainwater from utility lines, this piece represents early American telecommunications history. The aqua glass displays authentic production characteristics including internal bubbles and visible mold seams.
Heavy pressed glass body with drip points along the base skirt
Translucent aqua blue-green glass with internal seed bubbles
Embossed "HEMINGRAY" on face and "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on reverse
Attached to heavy curved iron mounting bracket with screw holes
Measures approximately 5.5 x 5 x 3 inches
Condition:
Embossed text is clear and legible. Drip points along the lower skirt display fleabites and chips typical of outdoor telegraph use. Iron bracket retains rustic surface rust and aged patina. Glass shows light soot and wear from historic utility service.
Thank you for all of your support!
